CmBootstrapContext.tsx:9, :28-30, :113-114 add roles and states(group) from bootstrap.vocabulary with a stable empty fallback.

non_blocking: useCmPagedList.ts:59-61: a failed load keeps the previous items and total, so after a filter change whose request fails, the admin CmPager (total path) still shows the previous filter's 'Page x of y, n records' under the error state. The old useCmAdminList cleared total and hid the pager. Suggested G1 fix: on failure set total to 0 (or have CmPager hide when error is set) without dropping the stale-response guard.

useCmAdminFormat (CmAdminShared.tsx:51-65) and useCmFormat (cmWorkspaceFormat.ts:151-161) are two formatter hooks over the same helpers; the admin one adds only the bootstrap default currency and the date(withTime, calendar)/time signature. Candidate for one hook with a currency default in G1.
CmShowcasePage.tsx:31-59 useShowcaseSection is a public paged-section hook that parallels useCmPagedList; it was outside the A14 pager scope and is left as is.

cmgap-U30-ui is UI-complete, but the server side (codemart-laravel cmgap-U30, CodeMartV1AIAnalysisCtl acceptProposal) does not read Idempotency-Key yet, so the end-to-end replay guarantee waits on that item.
